name: Magna Fortuna: The Gargantuan Fate and a Girl of Eternity
summary: A classic style turn-based RPG. One night while trying to sleep, Ayana Tomori is awoken by the sound of thunder and a brilliant light envelops her. When her sight returns, she finds herself in a strange new world.
